stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: When Kasady bites Eddie, he takes in a piece of Venom that becomes the red symbiote Carnage. Venom fights him at the cathedral and devours both Carnage and Kasady.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bonds with a piece of Venom to become Carnage. Venom devours him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The symbiote whose piece turns Cletus into Carnage. Devours him at the cathedral.

question: Kasady's prison interview is with Eddie while Venom is bonded inside him but silent. Does Venom being present through Eddie count as dealing with Kasady here, for a stage in Venom?

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Flash is a classmate on the academic decathlon team who keeps mocking Peter and Ned. At Liz's party he taunts them over Ned's claim that Peter knows Spider-Man.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A classmate who keeps mocking Ned and Peter.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's best friend, whom Flash mocks along with Peter.

question: Flash throws a wad of paper at Peter as Peter and Ned walk past his locker. Is sharing that moment enough for a Ned|Flash stage here?

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Wong is the librarian of Kamar-Taj who helps teach Stephen Strange, and they become close friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Kamar-Taj's librarian. Helps teach Strange and becomes a close friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Wong's student, who becomes a close friend.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: While Strange is lost in the Blip, Wong takes over as Sorcerer Supreme, and he warns Strange against casting the spell to make the world forget Peter Parker.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Strange's friend and the new Sorcerer Supreme. Warns Strange against the spell.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Wong's friend. Wong warns him against the spell to make the world forget Peter.

proposed.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
proposed.text: Strange and Wong save America Chavez from a demon in New York and try to protect her from Wanda at Kamar-Taj. Later, with Wong's help, Strange saves Chavez from Wanda at Mount Wundagore.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Close friend. Helps Strange protect America Chavez from Wanda.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Wong's friend. Fights beside him to protect America Chavez from Wanda.

their_evidence: Strange rescues Chavez from a demon in New York with help from Wong, the Sorcerer Supreme; Wanda attacks Kamar-Taj and captures Wong when Strange refuses to give up Chavez; at the end, with Wong's help, Strange saves Chavez from Wanda.
